description: Governor's Office- Central Province - Delegation of Power under the Central Provincial Council Co-operative Societies
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the delegation of powers under a provincial charter (Co-operative Societies Charter No. 10 of 1990, amended by Charter No. 4 of 1993) and references specific sections and regulations. It deals with legal/regulatory matters concerning cooperative societies rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification.
